## About
Erich's Lehigh Auto Body is a family owned and operated shop at 6637 W Touhy Ave in Niles, serving drivers across Chicagoland. We handle collision repair, frame repair, auto body painting and restoration on foreign and domestic vehicles, new or old.
Our goal is simple: high quality repairs done in a timely manner, with good communication from the first estimate to the day you pick up your car. Our mechanics speak Spanish, Polish and German along with English, so you can talk through your repair in the language you're most comfortable with.
We hold a 4.3 rating from 77 Google reviews. Stop by on a weekday or give us a call to set up a free estimate.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident for foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Frame repair: Our experienced mechanics fix and straighten your vehicle's frame, with the goal of getting it right the first time.
- Auto body painting: A new coat of paint to give your vehicle a new look, or to change its color.
- Auto restoration: Bodywork and restoration to bring back the look of your car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free on all of our auto work.

Q: Can I just stop by?
A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome.

Q: Do you offer warranties on parts?
A: We offer manufacturers' warranties on some of the auto parts we provide. Ask us about your repair when you come in.

I brought it to Erich’s Lehigh and they said it was really bad. The car didn’t drive straight. They put it on their frame machine and after hours they got it back to normal. It is now completely straight, with the exception of a couple body lines due to my installing of the body panels. But what they did was done great. The first photo is when the frame was bent. Second is now. I’m extremely happy. I know people that have used them for body work and from what I’ve seen it’s top notch. Great people to deal with. And the price was reasonable."
